keep_playing_why: Game B kept giving me something new every minute: the tide trick, a floating raft, a boat through the rocks, and a boss I beat by thinking with the sea. Game A was a nice tower defence but stage 1 was a walkover and most of the time I just waited for olives to walk down the path. A has more replay (stars, orders), but B gave me more wins I felt.
better_made_why: B has a clear one-step goal banner, a single memorable mechanic taught in the first 20 seconds, atmospheric 3D and sound, and a finished ending. A is polished and clear with good sound and combos, but its music dropped out in places and my build taps sometimes missed. B had short black loading flashes and a dead end after the finale.
furthest_A: Stage 1 The Cutting Board cleared with 3 stars (score 12,950, 20/20 lives); Stage 2 The Stovetop reached wave 10/10 and the JAR boss, lost with score 23,000 (best); second attempt lost at wave 9; third attempt at wave 6 when I stopped.
furthest_B: Finished the main story at about 5 min: Gullwick Harbour, Well Islet shard, floated Tam's boat, the Shellflats raft and the keeper's lens, sailed the Needles, beat the Undertow boss (3 knocks), and lit the lamp on the Stack for the end card ('0 of 5 lost things found'). After that I only wandered at night.
